shortDescription: Information module for Sda Layer2 Virtual Networks Count

options.name: associatedLayer3VirtualNetworkName
options.description: AssociatedLayer3VirtualNetworkName query parameter. Name of the associated layer 3 virtual network.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: fabricId
options.description: FabricId query parameter. ID of the fabric the layer 2 virtual network is assigned to.

options.name: trafficType
options.description: TrafficType query parameter. The traffic type of the layer 2 virtual network.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: vlanId
options.description: VlanId query parameter. The vlan ID of the layer 2 virtual network.

options.name: vlanName
options.description: VlanName query parameter. The vlan name of the layer 2 virtual network.
